card.name: Digits after a 3 and decimal point
card.fires_on: The digit right after a decimal point that follows the number 3, as in 3.6, 3.9 or 3.27. It also fires on the point in version names like 4.3BSD.

modes.label: Decimal digit after 3.
modes.description: A single digit after "3." in measurements, percentages or product strengths.

modes.label: Version number 3.2x
modes.description: The last digit of a Linux man-pages release number or a BSD version.
modes.example: This page is part of release 3.2<<7>> of the Linux man-pages project.

card.plain: It fires on the digit just after the decimal point in numbers that start with 3, such as 3.6% or version 3.27.
